**Role Purpose**

The Talent Sourcing Specialist will be responsible for building high-quality talent pipelines to support hiring across APAC. This role will proactively identify and engage niche technical and commercial talent across multiple markets, ensuring a steady flow of qualified candidates for critical business roles.

This position plays an important role in strengthening Talent Acquisition outcomes by accelerating time-to-fill, improving candidate quality, and enabling recruiters to focus on stakeholder engagement and hiring decisions.

**Sourcing & Pipeline Development**

* Partner closely with TA Partners across APAC to understand hiring plans, role requirements, and priority positions.

  + Construction Supervisors
  + Installation & Maintenance Mechanics
  + Estimation Engineers
  + Sales Engineers and Sales Representatives
  + Project Engineers and other field-based technical roles
* Utilize multiple sourcing channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, Workday, Avature, job boards, internal databases, referrals, and proactive market mapping.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines aligned with business demand and market trends.

**Candidate Engagement**

* Conduct initial screening conversations to assess experience, technical fit, and interest level.
* Maintain consistent candidate engagement to improve experience and reduce drop-offs.
Support stronger offer acceptance through effective communication and relationship management.  

**Market Intelligence & Insights**

* Provide insights on talent availability, competitor activity, compensation trends, and hiring challenges across APAC markets.
* Contribute to hiring forecasts, pipeline tracking, and demand planning activities.

**Collaboration & Process Excellence**

* Work closely with TA Partners to align sourcing strategy with business priorities.
* Present curated and qualified candidate shortlists to support efficient hiring decisions.
* Ensure consistency and quality in sourcing practices across markets.

**Performance Indicators**

* Quality and conversion of candidate pipelines
* Speed of shortlist delivery for priority roles
* Reduction in aged requisitions
* Candidate engagement and offer acceptance outcomes
* Hiring manager and TA partner satisfaction

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4–5 years of experience in sourcing or recruiting, preferably within engineering, construction, manufacturing, or field services.
* Experience supporting multi-country or regional hiring across APAC.
* Proven ability to source niche and technical talent across multiple roles.

* Strong expertise in Boolean search, talent mapping, and proactive sourcing techniques.

* High attention to detail with ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable working across time zones in a fast-paced environment.

title: WalkMe Process Developer
description:
WalkMe Process Developer – Digital Adoption  
  
Role Purpose  
Centrica is looking for an experienced WalkMe Process Developer to support the design, development and continuous improvement of digital adoption solutions across enterprise applications and business processes.  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, process owners, product teams, change teams and technology specialists to understand user journeys, identify areas of friction and develop effective WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) solutions that improve user experience, process compliance, productivity and adoption.  
The WalkMe Process Developer will translate business processes and user requirements into intuitive in application guidance, automation and contextual support, helping users complete activities correctly and efficiently while reducing dependency on traditional training and manual support.  
  
The role requires a combination of WalkMe development, process analysis, user experience thinking, testing, analytics and stakeholder management capability.  
  
  
  
Certifications – Desirable  
Relevant certifications would be advantageous, particularly:  
  
. WalkMe Digital Adoption Technical Certification  
. WalkMe Builder / Developer certifications  
. WalkMe Project Management or Solution Architecture certifications  
. Change Management certification  
. Lean / Process Improvement certification  
  
Certification should complement, rather than replace, strong hands on WalkMe development experience.  
Key Competencies  
WalkMe DevelopmentAble to independently design, build, test and maintain high quality WalkMe solutions.  
Process ThinkingUnderstands the underlying business process rather than simply adding guidance to application screens.  
User Centred DesignDesigns digital adoption experiences around what users need to successfully complete their work.  
Analytical ThinkingUses adoption and behavioural data to identify problems and measure whether solutions are effective.  
Problem SolvingAble to troubleshoot complex WalkMe behaviour and application interaction issues.  
Stakeholder ManagementComfortable working directly with business process owners, application teams and transformation stakeholders.  
Continuous ImprovementUses analytics, feedback and changing business requirements to continually improve digital experiences.  
Expected Outcomes  
The WalkMe Process Developer will help Centrica to:  
  
. Improve adoption of enterprise applications and new technology.  
. Simplify complex user journeys.  
. Reduce process errors and rework.  
. Improve process compliance.  
. Increase employee productivity.  
. Reduce dependency on traditional training and support.  
. Accelerate adoption following technology releases and business process changes.  
. Provide contextual support directly within enterprise applications.  
. Generate measurable insight into user behaviour and adoption.  
. Identify opportunities for further process simplification and automation.  
. Improve the overall digital employee experience.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

1. WalkMe Solution Development  
  
. Design, configure, develop and maintain digital adoption solutions using WalkMe.  
. Build WalkMe components including: Smart Walk Thrus SmartTips Launchers ShoutOuts Resources Surveys Onboarding Tasks Menus and contextual guidance  
. Configure WalkMe Rules and Conditions to deliver relevant guidance based on user context.  
. Develop solutions that simplify complex business processes and improve user productivity.  
. Ensure WalkMe content is intuitive, maintainable and aligned with agreed user experience standards.  
. Optimise existing WalkMe solutions based on user feedback and analytics.  
  
2. Process Analysis & Improvement  
  
. Engage with process owners and business stakeholders to understand current business processes and user journeys.  
. Analyse existing processes to identify: User pain points Repetitive activities Process errors Training gaps Compliance issues Navigation challenges Opportunities for automation  
. Translate process requirements into effective digital adoption solutions.  
. Challenge unnecessary process complexity and recommend opportunities for simplification.  
. Support broader process improvement initiatives across Centrica.  
  
3. Digital Adoption & User Experience  
  
. Design WalkMe experiences that help users adopt new applications, functionality and business processes.  
. Develop contextual, in application guidance rather than relying solely on traditional training materials.  
. Ensure guidance is presented to the right user, at the right point in the process.  
. Reduce user effort and improve completion rates for key business processes.  
. Design effective onboarding journeys for new systems and functionality.  
. Work with UX, Product and Change teams to ensure a consistent employee/user experience.  
  
4. Application & Process Onboarding  
  
. Support onboarding of enterprise applications and business processes onto the WalkMe platform.  
. Assess candidate processes for suitability for digital adoption.  
. Understand application behaviour, workflows and user personas.  
. Define the appropriate WalkMe approach for each application/process.  
. Configure and validate WalkMe implementation across development, test and production environments.  
. Support deployment and release of new WalkMe content.  
  
5. WalkMe Analytics & Insights  
  
. Use WalkMe Analytics / Insights to understand user behaviour and adoption.  
. Monitor: Walk Thru usage Process completion Drop off points User engagement Feature adoption Error/failure patterns  
. Analyse user journeys to identify areas where additional guidance or process improvement is required.  
. Establish measurable adoption and success criteria.  
. Provide stakeholders with insights on adoption, usage and business outcomes.  
. Use data to continuously improve WalkMe solutions.  
  
6. WalkMe Editor & Technical Configuration  
  
. Develop solutions using the WalkMe Editor.  
. Configure element selection and page recognition.  
. Develop robust rules and segmentation.  
. Troubleshoot issues caused by dynamic web page behaviour or application changes.  
. Ensure WalkMe content remains resilient when underlying applications are updated.  
. Apply appropriate technical standards for maintainability and performance.  
. Work with application development teams where technical support is required.  
  
7. JavaScript / CSS / Web Technologies  
Where standard WalkMe functionality requires extension:  
  
. Use JavaScript to support advanced WalkMe behaviour.  
. Apply HTML/CSS knowledge to customise presentation and user experience.  
. Understand DOM structures and web application behaviour.  
. Troubleshoot element selection and application compatibility issues.  
. Develop technical solutions without unnecessarily increasing implementation complexity.  
  
8. Testing & Quality Assurance  
  
. Develop and execute test scenarios for WalkMe solutions.  
. Validate content across relevant user personas, applications, browsers and environments.  
. Perform regression testing following application changes.  
. Ensure WalkMe content does not negatively affect underlying application functionality.  
. Validate segmentation and conditional logic.  
. Resolve defects prior to production deployment.  
. Maintain appropriate quality and release controls.  
  
9. Stakeholder Engagement  
Work closely with:  
  
. Business Process Owners  
. Digital Adoption teams  
. Product Owners  
. Business Analysts  
. Change & Transformation teams  
. Learning & Development  
. UX teams  
. Application teams  
. Software Engineers  
. Service Management  
. Security  
. Business users  
  
Facilitate workshops to understand requirements, demonstrate solutions and gather feedback.  
Translate technical WalkMe capabilities into understandable business outcomes for non technical stakeholders.  
10. Change & Transformation Support  
  
. Support major technology and business transformation initiatives through digital adoption.  
. Develop WalkMe content to support new system releases and process changes.  
. Work with Change teams to understand user impact assessments.  
. Provide targeted guidance for affected user groups.  
. Support phased deployments and adoption campaigns.  
. Reduce reliance on classroom training, lengthy manuals and repetitive support activity where contextual guidance provides a better user experience.  
  
11. Governance & Standards  
  
. Follow agreed Centrica digital adoption standards and governance.  
. Maintain reusable WalkMe design patterns and templates.  
. Ensure appropriate naming, documentation and version control standards.  
. Maintain clear ownership of WalkMe content.  
. Establish appropriate review and approval processes.  
. Ensure obsolete guidance is retired when applications or processes change.  
. Contribute to development of WalkMe best practices across the organisation.  
  
12. Security, Privacy & Accessibility  
  
. Ensure WalkMe solutions comply with Centrica security and data protection requirements.  
. Avoid exposing sensitive information through WalkMe content.  
. Apply appropriate user segmentation and access considerations.  
. Ensure digital adoption content meets relevant accessibility requirements.  
. Work with Security and application teams where solutions interact with sensitive processes or data.  
  
13. Continuous Improvement  
  
. Continuously evaluate WalkMe solutions and identify opportunities for optimisation.  
. Use analytics, user feedback and support data to prioritise improvements.  
. Identify opportunities to replace manual guidance with contextual digital assistance.  
. Promote reusable solutions and standards.  
. Stay current with new WalkMe capabilities and digital adoption best practices.  
. Recommend new platform capabilities that could improve employee experience or operational efficiency.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Mandatory Skills & Experience  
The successful candidate should have hands on experience with:  
  
. WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform  
. WalkMe Editor  
. Smart Walk Thrus  
. SmartTips  
. Launchers  
. ShoutOuts  
. WalkMe Rules / Conditions  
. User segmentation  
. WalkMe Analytics / Insights  
. Digital adoption solution design  
. Business process analysis  
. User journey analysis  
. Requirements gathering  
. Testing and troubleshooting  
  
The candidate should also demonstrate:  
  
. Experience translating business processes into digital adoption solutions.  
. Strong process analysis and problem solving capability.  
. Experience working directly with business stakeholders.  
. Understanding of user experience and usability principles.  
. Ability to analyse user behaviour and adoption data.  
. Strong documentation and communication skills.  
. Experience working within enterprise technology environments.  
  
Desirable Technical Skills  
Experience with the following would be advantageous:  
  
. JavaScript  
. HTML  
. CSS  
. DOM / browser developer tools  
. APIs and web applications  
. Microsoft 365  
. Dynamics 365  
. Salesforce  
. ServiceNow  
. SAP  
. Workday  
. Power Platform  
. Power BI  
. Microsoft Copilot  
  
Experience implementing WalkMe across one or more large enterprise applications would be particularly valuable.  
Desirable Digital Adoption Experience  
  
. WalkMe implementation across large user populations.  
. Enterprise Digital Adoption Platform programmes.  
. Application onboarding and adoption.  
. User behaviour analytics.  
. Change management.  
. Employee experience improvement.  
. Learning/training transformation.  
. Process optimisation.  
. Digital transformation programmes.  
  
Candidate Profile  
The ideal candidate is not simply a WalkMe content builder.  
The strongest candidate should be able to take a business process such as:  
“Users are struggling to complete this process correctly and are generating high volumes of support requests.”  
and work through:  
Process understanding user journey analysis pain point identification WalkMe solution design development testing deployment adoption measurement continuous improvement.  
The candidate should therefore combine:  
WalkMe Development + Process Analysis + Digital Adoption + UX Thinking + Analytics + Stakeholder Management  
with sufficient technical capability to troubleshoot complex enterprise applications.  
Candidates with backgrounds such as WalkMe Developer, WalkMe Builder, Digital Adoption Developer, DAP Consultant, Digital Adoption Analyst or Process Improvement Developer would be particularly relevant.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1762061

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

Help turn technology insight into successful transactions. As an Assistant Director in the Client Technology Transaction Office (CTTO), you will lead technology delivery on assigned transactions across EY’s global business, from diligence and planning through execution, full integration or separation, and transition to ongoing operations. Our remit spans acquisitions, divestitures and separations, intellectual property (IP) assignments and business wind-downs. You will bringspecialists and business stakeholders together, translate complex issues into clear recommendations and help deliver outcomes that protect value and enable change.

This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership, work across borders and build experience across a diverse transaction portfolio. You will help shape better ways of working, develop colleagues and see your contribution through from early assessment to delivery. If you enjoy connecting technology, people and business priorities, we would welcome your application.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead technology diligence on assigned transactions, bringing together specialist assessments of technology, data, security and IP to identify material risks, dependencies, delivery options and costs.
* Turn diligence findings into practical delivery plans for acquisitions, divestitures and separations, IP assignments and business wind-downs, reflecting the objectives, critical dependencies and needs of each transaction.
* Build trusted relationships with deal sponsors, transaction counterparties (c-suite) and delivery teams; communicate progress, options and changes clearly, tailoring technical messages to the audience.
* Coordinate technology specialists and partner functions, including Architecture, Information Security, Talent, Risk, Independence, Data Protection and Procurement, to resolve cross-functional dependencies.
* Manage technology execution through Day 1 readiness and full integration or separation, coordinating the transfer, migration or retirement of technology, data and services as appropriate to the transaction.
* Take ownership of agreed scope, plans, budgets and milestones; manage risks and issues, assure deliverable quality and confirm a clear handover to operational owners at completion.
* Apply relevant delivery methods and governance, share lessons learned and recommend practical improvements to CTTO’s playbooks and ways of working.
* Lead practical AI-enabled improvements in transaction workflows using approved tools, helping colleagues adopt them responsibly with appropriate confidentiality, human review and checks for accuracy, relevance and potential bias.
* Contribute to CTTO priorities and related initiatives agreed with the CTTO leader, bringing ideas that improve delivery, resource use and stakeholder experience.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Work independently within agreed objectives and governance, balancing competing priorities, urgency and available resources.
* Grasp technical and business issues quickly, question assumptions and draw on specialist input to develop evidence-based recommendations.
* Identify and assess risks early, resolve issues within your remit and escalate material risks or decisions to leadership with clear options and implications.
* Recommend trade-offs on scope, cost, timing and resources, consulting stakeholders and obtaining approvals where required.
* Adapt plans as transaction needs evolve, communicate changes promptly and maintain objectivity, integrity and delivery quality under pressure.
* Proven ability to lead complex technology projects, bringing structure to ambiguity and delivering agreed outcomes across global teams.
* Broad understanding of technology, data, security and service operations, with the judgement to involve specialists rather than needing to be an expert in every discipline.
* Strong analytical and commercial judgement, with attention to the detail that matters for transaction decisions, costs and quality.
* Credibility and confidence with senior stakeholders; able to build trust, challenge constructively and influence across organisational boundaries.
* Adaptability and sound judgement under pressure, with a collaborative approach to changing priorities and resolving challenges.
* An inclusive, globally aware leadership style that values different perspectives, supports colleagues and encourages learning and innovation.
* Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to make complex topics accessible through concise reports, presentations and conversations.
* Work with teams across geographies and time zones, with flexibility for meetings outside normal working hours when transaction needs require, while supporting sustainable working practices.
* Handle highly confidential transaction information with discretion, comply with relevant EY policies and information-handling requirements, and where required sign a transaction non-disclosure agreement.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have (to be removed)**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ IT-related experience, including leading complex technology projects and coordinating cross-functional delivery.
* Experience working with multi-location teams and senior business stakeholders in large programmes of work.
* Experience in technology diligence, integration, separation or related business change is valuable; you should be able to apply your delivery experience across different transaction types.

What we look for

  

**What we offer you**

  

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

  

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**About Payoneer**

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

**About Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM)**

Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM) is Payoneer's global workforce solutions business, helping companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent anywhere in the world. The business enables organizations to build international teams quickly and compliantly without the need to establish legal entities in every country where they hire.

As remote and distributed workforces become increasingly common, companies face challenges related to employment compliance, payroll, benefits administration, contractor management, and local labor regulations. Payoneer WFM simplifies these complexities through technology-enabled workforce solutions and in-country expertise.

**What We Do:** Payoneer WFM provides end-to-end solutions that help businesses:

* Engage and manage contractors compliantly
* Process global payroll across multiple countries and currencies
* Manage onboarding and offboarding processes
* Ensure compliance with local employment and labor laws
* Handle benefits administration and workforce operations
* Support international expansion without requiring entity setup

Today, Payoneer WFM supports businesses across more than 160 countries, enabling them to access talent globally while maintaining compliance and operational efficiency.

The platform enables businesses to:

* Hire employees and contractors in 160+ countries
* Run global payroll in 70+ currencies
* Manage onboarding, contracts, benefits, compliance, expenses, and offboarding from a single platform
* Navigate local labor laws, tax requirements, and employment regulations across jurisdictions.

Employer of Record (EOR): A key offering within WFM is Employer of Record (EOR). Under the EOR model, Payoneer WFM becomes the legal employer of an individual in their local country while the client company manages the employee's day-to-day responsibilities, goals, and performance.

This allows organizations to hire talent internationally without establishing a local subsidiary or legal entity. Payoneer WFM manages employment contracts, payroll, taxes, statutory benefits, and compliance requirements, enabling clients to focus on growing their business.

Why This Market Matters: The global workforce landscape has changed significantly over the last few years. Companies are increasingly adopting remote and distributed hiring models, allowing them to access talent regardless of geography. As a result, the demand for global employment solutions, international payroll, and compliance management has grown rapidly.

How WFM Fits Within Payoneer: Payoneer is widely recognized as a global financial technology company that enables businesses to send, receive, and manage cross-border payments worldwide. Workforce Management extends this mission by helping businesses not only move money globally but also hire and manage talent globally. Together, these solutions enable companies to build, operate, and scale international businesses more efficiently.

Payoneer WFM is helping redefine how companies build global teams, making international hiring simpler, faster, and more accessible for businesses around the world.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Analyst to support accurate and timely payroll delivery across assigned countries. You will validate payroll inputs, reconcile outputs, resolve discrepancies and coordinate with internal teams and payroll partners. You will also support entity and platform transitions and contribute to automation and AI initiatives that simplify global payroll.

**What you'll do:**

* Support payroll transitions between employing entities, payroll providers or platforms by validating employee data, opening balances and payroll results, and coordinating readiness for the first payroll cycle.
* Coordinate with payroll partners and internal teams to close pending inputs, approvals and discrepancies within agreed timelines, escalating risks that could affect payroll delivery.
* Investigate recurring payroll errors and exceptions, identify root causes and improve validation checks and processes to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain country-specific payroll procedures and support statutory reporting, reconciliations and audits in coordination with local payroll partners.
* Contribute to automation and AI initiatives by identifying manual tasks, documenting payroll requirements, testing workflows and validating outputs, helping us shape the future of Global Payroll

**Who you are:**

* 3-8 years of experience in payroll processing, input validation and reconciliation; exposure to multi-country payroll or payroll partner coordination is an advantage.
* Sound understanding of payroll calculations, tax and statutory requirements for the countries you have supported.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for validating data, reconciling payroll and investigating discrepancies.
* Comfortable working with payroll systems and learning new tools and workflows.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills and the ability to identify risks and resolve problems.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing deadlines and work independently.
* Eager to embrace automation and AI, continuously improve payroll delivery and help shape the future of global payroll.

**How you'll grow**

* Build expertise in multi-country payroll, entity transitions and process improvement while gaining hands-on experience with AI agent-powered workflows.
* Work alongside Product, Engineering and Operations to improve payroll accuracy, reduce manual effort and measure the impact of your contributions.

**Note:** **This role will be part of Payoneer WFM business unit.**

**Act as our customer's partner on the inside**
  
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*

**Do it. Own it.**
  
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*

**Continuously improve**
  
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*

*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly HR MIS reports.

* Effective monitoring of attendance and leave management.

title: Mid-level Consultant 1
description:
JOB DETAILS
  
  
**Type of contract :** Consultant Contract
  
  
**Level :** Level 2 - Middle
  
  
**Hiring Unit :** Communication and Information Sector (CI)
  
  
**Duty Station :** New Delhi
  
  
**Work location :** On site
  
  
**Duration of contract :** 6 months
  
  
**Hiring open to :** External candidates
  
  
**Application deadline (Midnight UTC+5 Time) :** 08/12/2026
  
  
**UNESCO Core Values:** Commitment to the Organization, Integrity, Respect for Diversity, Professionalism
  
  
OVERVIEW
  
  
Under the overall authority of the Director of the UNESCO Regional Office in New Delhi and the direct supervision of the Regional Adviser for Communication and Information, the consultant will support project launch, the inception phase and initial implementation until the national project team is in place.
  
  
UNESCO is implementing the European Union-funded project “Strengthening Media Safety, Digital Rights and Inclusive Policy Engagement in India”. The 36-month action strengthens digital rights and inclusive digital policy engagement through research, dialogue and capacity-building, while enhancing journalist safety, legal protection and enabling judicial environments. Implementation combines UNESCO technical guidance and convening with grants and other arrangements involving qualified local organizations.
  
  
The six-month assignment will establish the technical and operational foundations for delivery across the six project outputs and ensure a documented transition to the national project team. The international consultant will initiate and coordinate project implementation activities until the national project team is recruited and operational.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
ASSIGNMENTS
  
  
1.a. Project inception and planning
  
  
Prepare the consultancy workplan and a first-year implementation plan, with responsibilities, milestones and dependencies. Coordinate stakeholder consultations and consolidate needs-assessment, gender-analysis and safety-mapping findings. Support refinement of the theory of change, results framework, baselines, targets and monitoring and evaluation framework. Prepare the inception report and revised project documentation for UNESCO review. The proposal requires submission to the donor within 30 days after completion of the three-month inception phase; dates must be aligned with the actual project calendar.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
1.b. Technical preparation across project outputs
  
  
Prepare activity concepts, technical briefs and terms of reference for research on digital rights and platform governance (Output 1.1); policy dialogues, exchanges and fellowships (Output 1.2); and capacity-building on platform governance and accountability (Output 1.3). Prepare technical specifications for judicial and legal capacity-building (Output 2.1), legal assistance and safety/protection activities (Output 2.2), and legal-network learning and case-documentation activities (Output 2.3). Prioritize early activities through the approved workplan.
  
  
1.c. Calls for proposals and partner mobilization
  
  
Preparation of procurement plan for the project. Draft priority calls for proposals, application guidance, technical assessment criteria and reporting templates. Support applicant briefings, assessment documentation and due diligence with authorized colleagues and panels. Prepare partner workplans, deliverable schedules and onboarding materials covering reporting, inclusion, safeguarding and confidentiality. Maintain an application and agreement tracker. Award decisions remain with authorized bodies.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
1.d. Stakeholder coordination and initial delivery
  
  
Map relevant public authorities, regulators, judicial and academic institutions, media organizations, civil society and specialist providers. Prepare an engagement plan, briefing notes, agendas and meeting records. Coordinate agreed early consultations and technical activities, document follow-up and timely escalate matters requiring senior decisions.
  
  
1.e. Monitoring, risk management and reporting
  
  
Establish results, activity and partner-monitoring tools, with gender-sensitive indicators and appropriately disaggregated data. Maintain a risk register and support activity-specific safety and sensitivity assessments. Prepare draft confidentiality and information-handling arrangements with relevant specialists. Prepare monthly updates and inputs to Steering Committee and donor reporting. Submit sensitive communications for clearance and keep confidential protection activities separate from public visibility.
  
  
1.f. Transition and handover
  
  
Brief the incoming national team and transfer project tools and records. Prepare a final report and handover package covering activities, partners, grants, risks, decisions, outstanding commitments and a prioritized forward implementation plan.
  
  
CONTRACT DURATION
  
  
Six months
  
  
Long Description
  
  
DELIVERABLES
  
  
Provide interim day-to-day project management under the supervisor until the national project team is recruited and operational, coordinating delivery, partners, grants, expenditure with administrative colleagues, results, risks and reporting. Follow the approved timetable; do not assume assessments, consultations or tools are complete. Agree the workplan within ten working days. Payment requires UNESCO approval of these deliverables:
  
  
**2.a. End of Month 1:** Draft inception package
  
  
Establish coordination and a Year 1 plan covering activities, responsibilities, timelines, expenditure and dependencies. Review documents, consult stakeholders and consolidate needs, gender and safety-mapping findings. Draft the inception report and refinements to the theory of change, results framework, baselines, targets and M&E framework. Prepare priority calls, guidance, assessment criteria and reporting templates; support selection and due diligence under the approved schedule. Establish a stakeholder map, engagement plan, application/agreement tracker and risk register. Prepare priority concepts, briefs, terms of reference or specifications.
  
  
**2.b. End of Month 2:** Final inception package and progress
  
  
Finalize the inception report and revised documents incorporating UNESCO's comments by the agreed internal deadline, allowing clearance and donor submission within 30 days after the three-month inception phase. Submit technical documents to the Regional Advisor in Delhi; update plans and trackers. Initiate priority activities; advance calls, partner selection and implementation arrangements. Report activity/grant progress, planned/actual expenditure available, and required decisions/actions.
  
  
**2.c. End of Month 3:** Implementation and partner mobilization
  
  
Report progress on sequenced research, policy, capacity-building and legal/safety-support activities. Support assessment, due diligence, agreements, partner workplans and deliverable schedules. Onboard partners on reporting, inclusion, safeguarding and confidentiality. Draft information-handling arrangements with specialists; support safety/sensitivity assessments and maintain consultation records. Obtain clearance for sensitive communications; separate confidential protection work from public visibility. Update the milestones, grants, results, expenditure and risks dashboard. Prepare scheduled quarterly Steering Committee documents and address donor inception comments.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
**2.d. End of Month 4:** Delivery review
  
  
Review milestones, deliverables and evidence within the consultant’s remit; coordinate specialist reviews. Follow up delays, quality issues and constraints; escalate decisions. Submit a management report, updated dashboard, corrective actions and sequencing/expenditure forecast adjustments. Follow up missing baseline/monitoring information, maintain gender-sensitive indicators and disaggregated data, update risks and safety assessments, and apply inclusion, confidentiality and safeguarding measures.
  
  
**2.e. End of Month 5:** Transition
  
  
Maintain coordination and partner follow-up. Submit a dashboard and handover plan covering responsibilities, activities, commitments, deadlines, expenditure and unresolved issues. Brief incoming personnel or UNESCO focal points; transfer agreed duties, continue untransferred functions and document completed/outstanding transfers.
  
  
**2.f. End of Month 6:** Final report and handover
  
  
Report workplan/results progress, activity/grant/partner status, expenditure reconciled with administrative colleagues, risks and decisions. Document handover to the national team or UNESCO focal points of project, technical and stakeholder records, trackers, monitoring tools, risk register, decisions and commitments, with a prioritized three-month plan and outstanding follow-up. Prepare scheduled quarterly Steering Committee documents.
  
  
All outputs require UNESCO clearance. The consultant prepares, coordinates and documents; approvals, awards, financial commitments and delegated authority remain with authorized UNESCO officials/bodies.
  
  
COMPETENCIES - Core (C) & Managerial (M)
  
  
Communication (C)
  
Accountability (C)
  
Innovation (C)
  
Knowlegde sharing and continuous improvement (C)
  
Planning and organizing (C)
  
Results focus (C)
  
Teamwork (C)
  
  
For detailed information, please consult the UNESCO Competency Framework .
  
  
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
EDUCATION
  
  

* Advanced university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in international relations, political sciences, social sciences, journalism, law, human rights, public policy, international development or a related field.

WORK EXPERIENCE
  
  

* At least four years of relevant professional experience in programme coordination or implementation in digital rights, freedom of expression, media development, journalist safety, democratic governance or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience in results-based planning, implementation tools and reporting.
* Experience preparing calls for proposals, terms of reference, partner assessment tools or grant-monitoring arrangements.
* Experience coordinating diverse stakeholders, including civil society and public or professional institutions.
* Proven experience drafting analytical reports, technical briefs and programme documentation

Long Description
  
  
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Knowledge of UNESCO’s work to promote freedom of expression and the safety of journalists.
* Strong analytical, drafting, organizational and planning skills.
* Ability to translate project results frameworks into practical implementation arrangements.
* Diplomatic communication and effective working relationships in multicultural environments.
* Gender-responsive and inclusive programme design; risk awareness and confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines and seek timely guidance.
* Proficiency in office software, including Word and Excel.

LANGUAGES
  
  

* Excellent knowledge (written and oral) of English

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
WORK EXPERIENCE
  
  

* Experience with EU-funded programmes or UN projects.
* Experience with UN System and understanding of their functioning and procedures.
* Knowledge of India’s media, digital governance and civil society landscape.
* Familiarity with UNESCO’s work on freedom of expression, journalist safety and digital platform governance.
* Experience integrating safeguarding and do-no-harm approaches into programme delivery.
* Experience supporting project inception and transition to an incoming implementation team.
* Experience on projects related to rule of law in relevance to freedom of expression and journalists’ safety would be an asset.

APPLICATION PROCESS
  
  
Interested candidates should click on “Apply Now”, and or if the button is not visible, look for, download and complete the Employment History form (Word file). At the end of the Word file, insert extra pages with the following required information:
  
  

* A letter indicating how their qualifications and experience make them suitable for the assignment and how they think UNESCO contributes to enhancing media freedom and the safety of journalists (maximum 500 words).
* A brief technical proposal outlining their understanding of the assignment, proposed approach and methodology, key activities, and indicative work plan for delivering the expected outputs (maximum 1,000 words).
* CV or Employment History Form
* A competitive financial proposal for the assignment, quoted in USD and expressed as a monthly fee, with any anticipated travel costs, if applicable, indicated separately.

Long Description
  
  
ASSESSMENT
  
  

* Only applications providing the information requested under application procedure will be considered.
* Evaluation of qualified applicants may include an assessment exercise and a competency-based interview.

SELECTION AND RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  
  
Please note that all candidates must complete an on-line application and provide complete and accurate information, by the above deadline.
  
  
To apply, please visit the UNESCO Careers website . No modifications can be made to the application once submitted.
  
  
The process may include pre-recorded video interviews and/or written assessments, interviews with a Panel, as well as reference checks. In addition, candidates may be requested to provide additional information which may be pertinent to the position’s qualifications.

lndividuals from minority groups and indigenous groups and persons with disabilities are equally encouraged to apply.

title: Assistant Manager – Employee Services
description:
**Role Overview**

  

The **Assistant Manager – Employee Services** position at **London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG)** is a key leadership role within the Employee Services team. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced global organization. As part of the People Function, we empower leaders and colleagues, enabling LSEG to attract and nurture diverse talent, foster career growth, and deliver exceptional employee experiences.

This role is ideal for a proactive leader passionate about operational excellence, employee support, and people development.

  
  

Reporting to the **Senior Manager/Director – Employee Services** , you will lead the HR Service Delivery team, ensuring **delivery excellence, strong colleague experience (CX), and measurable business impact** across HR operations.

You will provide leadership in **troubleshooting complex Workday workflow challenges** , supporting HR Advisors with end-to-end workflow resolution, and ensuring downstream impacts are fully assessed and managed. You will oversee **Leave of Absence administration across global LSEG entities** , resolution of employee queries relating to HR processes and policies, and the delivery of timely, accurate, and high-quality support.

The role has end-to-end oversight of **employee lifecycle processes and Workday transactions delivered across onshore and offshore teams** , with a strong focus on quality, controls, operational performance, and continuous improvement. You will also **coach and develop the team, drive process simplification and improvements, strengthen operational governance, and partner with key stakeholders** to deliver seamless and consistent HR services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Employee Services team in delivering accurate, timely and high-quality HR services, ensuring agreed SLAs, quality standards and compliance requirements are consistently achieved.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for Employee Services processes, providing guidance to the team, HR Advisors and other participants on complex HR processes, policies and Workday transactions.
* Troubleshoot Workday workflow issues, assessing upstream and downstream impacts and coordinating with relevant teams to achieve effective end-to-end resolution.
* Oversee global Leave of Absence service delivery, ensuring cases and transactions are managed accurately, consistently and in accordance with applicable policies, process requirements and local compliance obligations.
* Provide guidance and support on HR workflows and employee lifecycle processes, ensuring potential impacts to employee data, pay and downstream activities are identified and addressed.
* Use ServiceNow, Workday and operational data to monitor service performance, identify trends and risks, assess team and process performance, and translate insights into appropriate actions.
* Ensure employee queries and transactions are resolved within agreed service levels, with a strong focus on accuracy, employee experience and avoiding preventable payroll or employee-impacting errors.
* Maintain effective operational controls, including process documentation, standard operating procedures, quality reviews, KPI monitoring, compliance requirements and audit readiness.
* Build team capability through regular coaching, knowledge sharing and feedback, ensuring team members maintain strong end-to-end process knowledge and can effectively manage both BAU and complex cases.
* Plan and manage operational capacity using workload and events calendars, proactively addressing resource gaps and providing hands-on support when required to maintain service continuity.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and service excellence, with clear accountability for outcomes and employee experience.
* Identify and lead opportunities to simplify, standardise, harmonise and automate HR processes, using operational insights and root-cause analysis to improve efficiency, quality and employee experience.
* Lead and contribute to global projects and cross-functional initiatives, working collaboratively across Employee Services, People Operations and wider PSS teams and influencing decisions to achieve effective outcomes.
* Build effective relationships with key stakeholders, providing clear operational insights, recommendations and presentations to support informed decisions and alignment on service delivery priorities.
* Establish mechanisms to capture stakeholder and employee feedback and convert relevant insights into measurable service improvements.
* Ensure performance, operational risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities are identified early, appropriately escalated and followed through to resolution.
* Support the timely and accurate completion of local compliance requirements, surveys, controls and audit requests.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
* 8–10 years of experience in people operations, employee services, or a related domain.
* Proven experience with HRIS platforms such as Workday. Should have been actively involved in CI via. AI and creative solutioning.
* Proficiency in ServiceNow or similar HR systems.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Customer-centric approach with a focus on enhancing employee experience.
* Ability to navigate complex, matrixed global environments.
* Self-motivated with strong business insight and problem-solving skills.
  

**ABOUT US:**

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

**Career Stage:**

Senior Associate  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.
